title: My Approach
lead: I invite you to experience your Self from a place of openness and acceptance of your embodied Being, honouring all parts of you as they are and gently allowing yourself to unfurl

blocks.heading: Counselling
paragraphs: Drawing on my background in Clinical Psychology (MSc), I facilitate an empathic space from which we embark on your healing journey. By exploring emotional, mental and behavioural patterns, you gain insight into your inner layers and workings. Compassionate and non-judgemental enquiry into the meaning and purpose of these patterns, through the lens of your accumulated life experiences, allows you to process the parts of yourself that are perhaps no longer serving you. We’ll further explore your values and ways to align yourself with them to live a more fulfilling and personally meaningful life.

My approach is integrative with a transpersonal perspective, which recognises the importance of exploring aspects of your life beyond the psyche. By honouring the interplay between mind, body and spirit, I aim to help you deepen your connection with your authentic self and with the world. By further integrating principles from humanistic therapies and acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), we attune the counselling to best suit your unique needs. I respect and value that you are the expert in your life and I aim to facilitate you in your healing.

blocks.heading: Energy Healing
paragraphs: Energy Healing is a general term for working with the body’s energy systems to support health and wellbeing, of which there are many different frameworks and modalities. My therapeutic work is rooted in the belief that our energetic bodies interact with our physical body, mental patterns and emotions. Thus, imbalances in one area may show up in a different aspect in life, such that healing is an embodied and integrative process. I approach Energy Healing as the process of redressing these imbalances by redirecting and harmonising energy to restore your inherent alignment and wholeness.

Energy Healing has been part of my life since I was a young child, both in receiving Healing and later exploring and expressing my own ways of working. In my various home-places and travels, I’ve met with many other healers from around the world, in both formal trainings and informal encounters. I deeply honour these opportunities to constantly learn new approaches and perspectives, just as I am honoured to learn from *you* and how you experience the world.

My intention is to offer a nurturing, trauma-informed space that allows you to meet yourself with compassion and acceptance of your emotional and somatic experiences that may arise during the treatment. My Energy Healing work is grounded and deeply attuned to your unique personal needs, drawing on my training in Reiki Jin Kei Do and Esoteric Soul Healing.
